title.en: An Act Declaring March 21 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of San Fabian, Province of Pangasinan, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 21 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of San Fabian, Province of Pangasinan, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 21 tháng 3 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị San Fabian, Tỉnh Pangasinan, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 21 มีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเทศบาล San Fabian จังหวัด Pangasinan เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 21 Maret setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kotamadya San Fabian, Provinsi Pangasinan, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 21 Mac setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Perbandaran San Fabian, Wilayah Pangasinan, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11132_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March 21 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of San Fabian, Province of Pangasinan, in commemoration of its founding anniversary.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
